panels.title: Form Submissions by Form Path — Success vs Failed

targets.query:
import "array"
import "dict"
import "strings"

names = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and r._field == "n8n_workflow_info")
  |> keep(columns: ["workflow_id", "workflow_name"])
  |> group()
  |> unique(column: "workflow_id")

// linha fantasma: findColumn falha se o stream estiver vazio
pairs = union(tables: [names, array.from(rows: [{workflow_id: "", workflow_name: ""}])])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.workflow_id + "|" + r.workflow_name}))
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

lookup = dict.fromList(
  pairs: array.map(
    arr: pairs,
    fn: (x) => {
      p = strings.splitN(v: x, t: "|", i: 2)
      return {key: p[0], value: p[1]}
    },
  ),
)

withNames = (tables=<-) => tables
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with workflow_name: dict.get(dict: lookup, key: r.workflow_id, default: r.workflow_id)}))

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_count"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["workflow_id"], set: ${workflow:json}))
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> withNames()
  |> group(columns: ["workflow_id", "workflow_name", "form_path"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {Success: 0.0, Failed: 0.0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      Success: accumulator.Success + (if r.status_code =~ /^[23]/ then r._value else 0.0),
      Failed: accumulator.Failed + (if r.status_code =~ /^[45]/ then r._value else 0.0),
    }),
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with endpoint: r.workflow_name}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "workflow_id", "form_path", "Success", "Failed"])

import "array"
import "dict"

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and r._field == "n8n_workflow_info")

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.workflow_id + "|" + r.workflow_name}))
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

  pairs: array.map(

  ),

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with workflow_name: dict.get(dict: lookup, key: r.workflow_id, default: r.workflow_id)}))

every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 1m) then v.windowPeriod else 1m

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "n8n" and (r._field == "n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_sum" or r._field == "n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_count"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["workflow_id"], set: ${workflow:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "_field", "workflow_id", "form_path"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["workflow_id", "form_path"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_count"] > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r["n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_sum"] / r["n8n_form_submission_duration_seconds_count"]}))
  |> withNames()
  |> group(columns: ["workflow_id", "workflow_name", "form_path"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "workflow_id", "workflow_name", "form_path"])
